name: Zoom In
description: Zooms in with an eased curve; by default the frame returns to normal when the motion ends, as in the source.

params.name: amp
params.description: Scale added by the end of the motion

params.name: duration
params.description: Length of the motion in seconds, shortened to the clip when the clip is shorter

params.name: hold
params.description: Keep the end of the zoom after the motion finishes instead of snapping back to normal

params.name: clip_time
params.description: Seconds since the start of the clip, filled by the editor

params.name: clip_duration
params.description: Length of the clip on the timeline in seconds, filled by the editor
